text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR to cover two breaking changes we need to publish: the "model" -> "model_id" param rename in the v2 API, and the embedding vector dim bump (512 -> 768). Need alignment on wording and a rollback-safe snippet.

raj: Thanks. Can you paste the minimal before/after snippets here so I can sanity-check dev teams won’t break? :eyes:

elaine: sure — old v1 example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"Summarize this..."}'
```

and new v2 example (docs PR uses this):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id":"redwood-alpha-v2","input":"Summarize this..."}'
```

sylvia: Important to call out: model param rename is mechanical; most SDKs will map both for a while but don't rely on that. Also the embed dim change is the bigger breaking thing for customers with precomputed indexes.

kevin: On the embed dim: we should add a clear banner + migration checklist example: how to detect mismatch and a snippet to re-index. I drafted a short CLI smoke test in the PR:
```bash
# check embed dimension returned by API
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id":"embed-basic-v2","input":"test"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
```

marta: Can we surface a one-click note for Managed Customers: if using Dedicated/Private, they need to coordinate re-index window with infra. Ops will schedule a maintenance window if they ask.

elaine: added a short paragraph in the PR about dedicated/private ops coordination. Also included a recommended transition approach: 1) run smoke test to detect dim, 2) re-index into new vector DB or create a new namespace, 3) gradual cutover with alias, 4) deprecate old repo after 30 days.

docs-bot: PR posted — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 :eyes: (labels: docs, breaking-change, migration)

raj: For the SDK snippets: can we include compatibility shims for node/python that accept both model and model_id keyed args so sample apps don't explode mid-release? Keep them short.

elaine: Yep — I added both a minimal shim and a note that the shim is temporary and will be removed in the next major. Example (python):
```python
def normalize_params(params):
    # accept legacy "model" or new "model_id"
    if 'model_id' in params:
        return params
    if 'model' in params:
        params['model_id'] = params.pop('model')
    return params
```

kevin: Love it. Add a single-line test assertion in the docs to verify behavior in CI:
```python
assert normalize_params({'model':'foo'})['model_id'] == 'foo'
```

marta: tiny wording nit: under the embeddings section call out approximate timeline for when we'll remove the 512 fallback (if any). Ops needs that for customer comms.

elaine: added a timeline note: 60 days of dual-support for hosted, consult for dedicated/private. Also added a short troubleshooting FAQ entry for "my index suddenly has wrong vector size".

raj: One more thing — links. We have a few existing docs that reference the old v1 endpoint. Can we run a grep and add automated PRs or redirects?

elaine: I ran a quick grep and included a list in the PR description; added a follow-up task to open automated redirect PRs for the top-20 pages.

kevin: Action items?
elaine: agreed action list in the PR: [1] Docs owners review + wording (sylvia, raj) [2] Add SDK shim snippets to the SDK repo for a compatibility release (kevin) [3] Ops coordination message for Dedicated/Private customers (marta) [4] Automated redirect PRs for other pages (elaine) [5] Add smoke-test CI job to docs samples (raj)

marta: I'll draft the ops note and ping customer success after we finalize timeline. :thumbsup:

raj: I'll add the CI smoke test and the list of pages to auto-redirect.

elaine: Thanks all — please review PR #4822 when you have 15m. If no blockers by EOD I'll merge and ship the deprecation notice banner. :shipit:
